title: Show that one restored helper edge misses the literal K mask
body:
## Summary
- The restored edge `h0 ^= h1`, `y ^= h0`, `h0 ^= h1` returns both helpers to their starting columns. The checker's literal mask names only `h0`. The column replay delivers `h0 XOR h1`.
- After the first gate, `h0` holds both columns. The two direct writes `y ^= h0` and `y ^= h1`, with no edge, deliver exactly the helpers they name.
- No 661-column replay and no new exponent. The paid profile cited by the phase-B note is unchanged by this three-gate check.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/helper-star-literal-k/verify.py`

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper-star-literal-k`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
